name: Memory Insensitive Octree Construction
definition: An algorithm to construct a coarse-to-fine level-of-detail hierarchy H from a simplified mesh (vertex file V_n and triangle file T) using external storage.
summary: Memory Insensitive Octree Construction is an out-of-core algorithm that builds a coarse-to-fine level-of-detail hierarchy bottom-up using external storage, avoiding multiple external sorts by retaining direct cluster IDs.
